Folks — reviewed the scenarios in GPU_Price_Scenarios.xlsx. Quick take:
- Indexation is preferable to pure pass-through; it allows us to set discrete re-pricing windows (quarterly) and caps.
- Recommend a symmetric band of +/- 15% with an automatic commercial review if the index exits the band for two consecutive quarters. The review can escalate to VP Sales + Head of Finance if the proposed adjustment exceeds 12% effective price change.
- For contractual language: we can commit to a maximum pass-through exposure of 8% per year (cumulative) unless execs approve otherwise. Anything beyond that needs CFO sign-off.

I attached a short sensitivity table and a suggested approval ladder.

Agree with Jonas. My recommended offer (to present to Halo):
- 12-month firm commit + optional 12-month extension with step-up discount if usage growth > 40% (measured by token consumption).
- Indexation: quarterly review against public GPU index; if movement > 15% for two quarters, activate review. We propose a "price collar": floor = -12%, cap = +10% relative to base unit price.
- Buffer: include a 10% short-term buffer available for the first 90 days at the committed rate; after that buffer can be converted into 3-month paid burst or folded into committed units.
- Approval: offers up to 12% discount OK at VP Sales. Any incremental discount beyond 12% or any pass-through exposure >8%/year requires CFO sign-off (Jonas).
